1 Inhalation: Triggered if the unit has 1 Inhalation or more.
2 Inhalations: Triggered if the unit has 2 Inhalations or more.
3 Inhalations: Triggered if the unit has 3 Inhalations or more.
Aim: Crossbow Damage of the next attack increased by 10%. Stackable
Ambush: Triggered when this unit attacks an engaged enemy from behind.
Attack Stance: Unlocks the offensive effects of attacks.
Blackout: Chance of missing their target increased by 50% for the next attack.
Bleeding: Loses 20% of their maximum Health at the end of their turn.
Bravery: A Bravery is a skill that unlocks new strategies in battle. Your troop can perform only one Bravery per round. Each Companion can use their Bravery only once per battle.
Burning: Loses 15% of their maximum Health. The fire spreads to adjacent units at the end of their turn. Removed if the unit is moved by a skill.
Censer: The effects of Inhalation and Purge depend on the censer the Thaumaturge has equipped:
Condemn: Damage increased by 30%. When this unit is killed, they grant 5 VP and apply Galvanization to all of their allies.
Confused: This unit cannot receive bonuses. Does not apply to champions.
Consecutive Shot: Triggered if a precision skill has already been used by this unit during this round.
Corrosion: Loses 15% of their maximum Armour at the end of their turn. Stackable
Corrosive Smoke: Applies 2 Corrosion per stack to adjacent units at the end of their turn or when a unit ends their turn while adjacent to this unit, then consumes one stack. Stackable (maximum: 6)
Critical Hit: Determines the % of chance an attack will land a critical hit and deal additional damage.
Defence Stance: Unlocks the defensive effects of attacks.
Deflection: Damage taken of the next attack reduced by 70%.
Deftness: Range of the next attack is doubled, and precision is enhanced.
Delirium: For each application, you can perform an additional Hysterical Pummelling attack. Stackable (maximum 6).
Disarm: Can no longer use skills requiring their weapon. Does not work against champions.
Dodge: Fully dodges the next attack. Cancelled if the unit moves.
Doping Smoke: Damage increased by 10%, Critical Damage increased by 10%, and Movement increased by 2 per application. Stackable (maximum: 5, currently: 0). Removed at the end of the turn.
Engaged: A unit next to an enemy is engaged in combat with it. Moving away (disengaging) triggers an attack of opportunity.
Exposed: Damage increased by 30% the next time this unit takes damage.
Fatal Blow: Triggered if this ability kills the target.
Fire: Applies Burning to all the units who go through it.
Frenzied Power: Every time this unit spends 1 VP, they gain Frenzied Power. Damage increased by 15% per stack (currently: 0%). After 10 applications, each subsequent application grants a 10% chance to lose control.
Frenzy: This unit's damage increases as their health decreases, and their attacks always land critical hits.
Fury: Damage of the next attack increased by 50%.
Guard: Guard reduces the damage of incoming attacks as long as the unit has Armor. Attacks from behind ignore 50% of this reduction.
Inhalation: Loses 5% of their Health per stack at the end of the turn. Stackable (maximum: 2)
Inhale: Gains 1 Inhalation. Cost increases by 1VP for each subsequent use until the end of the turn. Instant
Initiative: Triggered if the target has not yet played their turn this round.
Invigorating Smoke: At the end of the round, heals for 5% of Health then consumes one stack. Stackable (maximum: 10)
Irritant Smoke: Guard reduced by 50%, Damage taken increased by 20%.
Lone Wolf: Damage increased by 10%. Damage taken reduced by 10%.
Patience: Triggered if the target has already played their turn this round.
Perfect Delirium: After using a skill, immediately purge without using any Inhalation. This unit takes damage equal to 20% of their Health at the end of each turn.
Poison: Loses 5% of their maximum Health at the end of their turn. Stackable
Protective Smoke: Damage taken reduced by 5% per application. Stackable (maximum 50%).
Purge: Triggers the equipped Censer's Purge effect, then consumes all Inhalations. Instant
Rally: The next time this unit kills a unit this round, they gain 1 Valour Points.
Ready: Critical Hit guaranteed and Crossbow Damage increased by 50% for the next attack.
Relentless: After attacking, this unit executes an attack of opportunity. Removed if no longer engaged in combat.
Riposte: The next time this unit is attacked by their engaged opponent, they attack in return with an attack of opportunity. Cancelled if the unit moves.
Rivalry: Damage taken dealt by the engaged opponent reduced by 30%. Damage increased by 30% against the engaged opponent.
Smoke Zone: Applies Blackout to units in the area. Clears at the end of the round.
Tactical Assist: Adjacent allies' Critical Hit increased by 5% per application of this status. Stackable (it is not mentioned but maximum stack is 10 which is 50%)
Toxic Miasma: Applies 1 Poison per stack to adjacent units at the end of their turn or when a unit ends their turn while adjacent to this unit, then consumes one stack. Stackable (maximum: 6)
Valor Point: VP. Spent to use skills. Your troop earns them in combat through Valor passives and other effects.
Victorious: All of this unit's attacks are critical hits.
Vulnerability: The next attack suffered will be a critical hit.
Zeal: Critical Hit and Critical Damage increased by 30%.
